articles.title: New Jersey officials petition US Supreme Court over prediction markets
articles.description: New Jersey’s Attorney General and gaming authorities filed a petition for a writ of certiorari to the US Supreme Court over Kalshi offering sporting event contracts to residents.

articles.title: Wyoming adds Chainlink reserve verification to state-issued stable token
articles.description: Wyoming is using Chainlink to bring near-real-time reserve verification onchain for FRNT as the oracle provider expands its footprint across tokenized financial markets.

articles.title: Ondo urges SEC, CFTC to bring US stock perpetuals onshore
articles.description: Ondo says existing US securities laws can accommodate perpetual futures tied to individual stocks as regulators look to bring more derivatives activity onshore.

articles.title: Bitcoin’s apparent demand turns negative as price struggles with $77K
articles.description: One of Bitcoin’s onchain demand indicators turns negative again after a brief August rebound, as BTC price slipped below $77,000 amid a broader bond and equities sell-off.

articles.title: G20 members tout ‘clear pathways’ for digital asset innovation
articles.description: Officials in the G20, under the US’ presidency, recognized that digital assets could support “broad-based economic growth” and called for improvements in cross-border transactions.

articles.title: Sui DeFi protocol Full Sail to wind down after Switchboard incident
articles.description: Full Sail is shutting down after an attacker removed about $91,000 from three vaults during a security incident linked to oracle provider Switchboard.

articles.title: BTC will hit $1M by 2030... but Arthur Hayes is buying ETH instead
articles.description: Arthur Hayes says Bitcoin is going to grind higher from here, but Ethereum is his number one pick due to its potential to increase “3x to 5x pretty quickly.”

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Hashkey joins DTCC working group as first Asian crypto service provider
articles.description: Hashkey joined the DTCC’s working group on tokenization innovation as the first Asian crypto service provider to join with over 100 financial institutions, including Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan.

articles.title: Thai businessmen sue Tether for freezing $42M in $61M pig butchering case
articles.description: The plaintiffs didn’t dispute their involvement in the pig butchering scam, but claimed that Tether did not have the authority to freeze the $42 million at the time.

articles.title: Japan’s Remixpoint dumps altcoins, leaves 1,506 BTC as sole crypto bet
articles.description: Remixpoint sold $5.5 million in ETH, SOL, XRP and DOGE, booking a $736,000 net gain as it narrowed its crypto strategy to focus on Bitcoin.

articles.title: Thailand adopts crypto Travel Rule with self-custodial wallet checks
articles.description: Thailand adopted a crypto Travel Rule requiring digital asset operators to verify control of self-custodial wallets and retain transaction data for five years.

articles.title: Crypto industry urges SEC to avoid blanket novel ETF restrictions
articles.description: Grayscale, a16z, and the CCI asked the SEC to preserve existing classification rules and avoid treating novel exchange-traded products as a single category, while proposing different routes to clearer and faster reviews.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs notch best month of 2026 as BTC gains 25% in August
articles.description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs reduced their year-to-date net outflows by 66% as Bitcoin gained about 25% in August, while Ether ETFs turned positive YTD at $732 million and XRP ETFs reached $502 million.

articles.title: HYPE treasury firm Hyperliquid Strategies boosts equity facility to $2.5B
articles.description: The Nasdaq-listed company previously raised $647 million through the facility and accumulated about 29.3 million HYPE tokens.

articles.title: Core DAO plans emergency hard fork after validators drew excess rewards
articles.description: Core says the incident is contained and its planned forward upgrade will not roll back the network or reverse previously confirmed transactions.

articles.title: Crypto-backed PAC scales back ad spending in Massachusetts primary
articles.description: The $189,000 in media spending to support Representative Jake Auchincloss marked Fairshake’s latest attempt to influence the 2026 elections with funds from the crypto industry.

articles.title: Binance expands TradFi push with options on 1,000 US stocks, ETFs
articles.description: The launch gives eligible non-US users access to physically settled options on more than 1,000 US stocks and ETFs through a single Binance account.

articles.title: UK crime agency froze $13.5M amid probe into Premier League crypto sponsor
articles.description: UK authorities froze $13.5 million in cash following a January 2025 order from the Westminster Magistrates’ Court as part of an investigation into Sorare.

articles.title: SEC proposes broad update to decades-old transfer agent rules with blockchain nod
articles.description: The proposal would modernize rules largely unchanged since the 1980s, addressing blockchain-based recordkeeping, tokenized securities and increasingly automated market infrastructure.

articles.title: Kalshi issues first lifetime ban for Republican politician over insider bets
articles.description: The prediction platform permanently banned George Santos and issued a three-year suspension for Laurie Buckhout after investigations into using insider information on event contracts.

articles.title: BofA, Citi, Goldman Sachs among 21 institutions planning stablecoin launch
articles.description: The planned venture will initially focus on a US dollar stablecoin before expanding to other G7 currencies, with a euro-denominated offering next.

articles.title: Ethena launches USDe payments app, offers 6% rewards
articles.description: The self-custodial app brings USDe into everyday payments, savings and cross-border transfers, with annualized rewards of up to 6%.

articles.title: Bitcoin stays flat as global bond bear market rages on, pushing JGB to high
articles.description: Global bond yields hit multi-decade highs today as Japan’s 10-year JGB yield reached a 30-year peak, keeping Bitcoin steady near $78,000.

articles.title: Fake Claude desktop app spreads crypto-stealing malware
articles.description: RevStealer targets more than 50 crypto wallets alongside browser passwords, cookies, messaging data and selected documents.

articles.title: Does the Bitcoin rally mean we haven’t wasted our lives in crypto?
articles.description: Crypto is showing signs of life again, but its biggest wins look different from what early believers imagined. After a decade of building, has it all been worth it?

articles.title: Asia sees digital asset custody infrastructure deals from Ripple, Coincheck
articles.description: Ripple was among the latest blockchain companies to sign a strategic partnership to build more custody and tokenized asset management solutions for Asian institutional participants.

articles.title: Kast launches stablecoin-powered business platform after $80M raise
articles.description: Kast aims to onboard between 1,000 and 5,000 active businesses to its new platform by the end of 2026.

articles.title: Lazarus Group-linked addresses move $30M through Hyperliquid
articles.description: Crypto wallets linked to the OFAC-sanctioned Lazarus Group moved $30 million in digital assets through Hyperliquid, weeks after regulators said they were working on a path to introduce the exchange into US markets.

articles.title: London Stock Exchange partners with Kraken parent for tokenized UK stocks: FT
articles.description: The London bourse operator is seeking to offer 24/5 exposure to UK-based tokenized equities, as more TradFi institutions explore tokenized equities offerings.
